reels.caption:
Here is the perfect 3 day itinerary at the Amalfi Coast ⬇️

DAY 1 - Positano & Amalfi
• Morning: Arrive in Positano early to explore before the crowds. Walk down Via Cristoforo Colombo for the iconic postcard view 🙌🏻
• Visit Spiaggia Grande & walk along the shore. Check out Fornillo Beach for a more secluded beach 🏖️
• Afternoon: Take a ferry (or bus) to Amalfi Town
• Visit Amalfi Cathedral (Duomo di Amalfi) ⛪️
• Relax at Marina Grande Beach or visit Fiordo di Furore (a stunning fjord-like beach)
• Evening: Have dinner at Ristorante DA GEMMA (seafood & pasta with a view) 🍝

DAY 2 - Ravello & Atrani
• Morning: Take a bus or taxi up to Ravello, a peaceful hilltop town with breathtaking views🫶🏻
• Visit Villa Rufolo & Villa Cimbrone (the Terrace of Infinity has one of the best panoramic views of the coast) 🌸
• Lunch: Eat at Ristorante Belvedere or Trattoria Da Lorenzo
• Afternoon: Walk to Atrani, just a 10-minute walk from Amalfi.
• Relax at Spiaggia di Atrani
• Evening: Enjoy a romantic dinner at Le Arcate Atrani by the water

DAY 3 - Capri & Anacapri
• Morning: Take a ferry to Capri from Positano or Amalfi
• Rent a boat & tour around the island (must-see: Blue Grotto, Faraglioni Rocks, and Marina Piccola).
• Afternoon: Take the funicular up to Piazzetta di Capri, then visit Gardens of Augustus for epic coastal views.
• Head to Anacapri & ride the Monte Solaro chairlift for the best panorama of the island. • Evening: Ferry back & have a sunset dinner at Il Riccio (Capri) or La Sponda (Positano)
